pid.description: Persistent identifier, issued by scripts/assign_identifiers.py and recorded in identifiers.csv. Opaque, never changed, reassigned or deleted. See IDENTIFIERS.md. URI: https://w3id.org/humeta/construct/<pid>.

broader.description: id of a broader construct, if any.

app_variable_keys.description: Variable keys from the earlier Module 2 that map to this construct (used to convert old variable plans).

eric.description: ERIC Thesaurus descriptors for the construct (see the HuMeta profile's crosswalks/eric_descriptor_status.json).

retired.description: The governance committee took this construct off the shared list. It is kept, never deleted, so studies that used its id still resolve; new studies should use replaced_by, if given.

replaced_by.description: The id of the construct to use instead.

naming.description: Where the construct's official name (label) comes from. In order: an ERIC Thesaurus descriptor with exactly the same meaning; else an ICPSR Subject Thesaurus term with exactly the same meaning; else the name as first published (priority of first use, as in biological nomenclature), anchored to that source and its definition. Other names are kept as synonyms.

term.description: The name exactly as the authority or first source gives it. The label must equal it unless status is unresolved.

url.description: The ERIC descriptor page, ICPSR term page, or the first source (DOI link or other address).

citation.description: First use: full reference of the publication that first named the construct.

status.description: needs_check: proposed, to be confirmed by the governance committee. verified: confirmed. unresolved: no authority term and no agreed first use yet; the label is provisional.

note.description: Earlier precursors, scope differences, or candidates still to check.

reviewed_by.description: Who on the governance committee confirmed the name (governance/construct-names/<id>.yml).

reviewed_on.description: When the committee confirmed the name.
